title: Build seven survivor classes, nine bosses and six distinct arena layouts
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Adds Tank, Mage, Engineer and Assassin to the authoritative local/Colyseus loop, bringing all seven classes, 378 skill nodes, 63 specialization paths and 28 weapons into play. Tank barriers/charges/team shields, Mage sigils/wards/pulses, Engineer turrets/barricades/Siege Engine and Assassin veil/blink/empowered steps have real collision, ownership, damage and replicated state. Protocol 8 includes kit state and bounded local v7 migration.

Six maps now have different obstacle arrangements and playable sizes: Gatehouse 1600x1000, Triage 1600x900, Ossuary 1300x1000, Chapel 1400x920, Foundry 1500x850 and Crypt 1240x880. Setup, authoritative movement, prediction, Accord access, route rotation and Widow gates share these layouts. Fifty spawn positions and required routes remain reachable.

Retains the nine-boss Quarantine expansion and nine original themes. Adds independently drawn directional runs, four classes of weapon/specialization illustrations and painted construct/cover props, with exact native requests, rejected attempts and independent pixel/hash audits. Full rendered/action/listening and human/device acceptance remain open.

Validation is recorded in reviews/runtime-verification.json and class-completion art audit reports. Full roster/routes, durable profiles/rankings, Windows/LAN release and WAN/endurance acceptance remain in development. Public hosting remains the old protocol-4 Site under a different account; source and Wiki publication do not redeploy it. Keep draft and main protected.
